description.body: Installs **Ashita v4 Beta** next to your existing launcher inside this prefix so both can boot the same Final Fantasy XI installation. Ashita is cloned into `drive_c/AshitaV4` (edit `ASHITA_DIR` in this manifest before adding it to use another folder). Every `config/boot/*.ini` file shows up as a launch target; the boot profile is passed to `Ashita-cli.exe` as its only argument.

**Ashita does not officially support Linux.** Under Wine, load atom0s' `winefix` plugin from the Ashita console (`/load winefix`, or add it to the `[ashita.plugins]` section of your boot profile) to work around known Wine hooking issues. Ask in the Ashita Discord `#linux` channel for Ashita-specific help; Lumoria issues are only for the Final Fantasy XI installation itself.

steps.description: Clone Ashita v4 Beta into the prefix

actions.name: Update Ashita
actions.description: This **git pulls** the repo and overwrites **ALL** git-managed files. **Do not** run it while the game is running.
